描述_EN: ancient bronzes were highly regarded in the song period (960-1279), and they were also being copied in the ming (1368-1644). inlaid bronzes were particularly valued by collectors. the inlaid patterns on this bronze censer are based on ancient bronze designs, but interpreted in a bold, schematic fashion.
描述_ZN: 古代青铜器在宋代（960-1279）被高度重视，在明代（1368-1644）也被仿制。 镶嵌的青铜器特别受到收藏家的重视。 这个青铜器上的镶嵌图案是以古代青铜器的设计为基础的，但以一种大胆的、图解的方式进行解释。
